text:
matt: FYI — support flagged a 404 hitting an old anchor from a partner blog: /guides/kv-cache#tips. Quick grep shows the anchor header was renamed in the merge earlier this quarter.

anya: Can you drop the file/line? Ill patch.

matt: docs/guides/kv-cache.md around the header section. Old anchor was #tips, new one is #best-practices.

docs-bot: :warning: link-scan: unreachable anchor /guides/kv-cache#tips referenced by external link (severity: medium).

oliver: Small fix options: 1) update external blog (partner) — takes time, or 2) add redirect_from frontmatter on docs/guides/kv-cache.md to preserve old shortlink. I'd add the frontmatter so external links keep resolving.

anya: Agreed. I'll open a tiny PR to add redirect_from: ["/guides/kv-cache"] and change any internal absolute links. Will also add a one-line test in docs/link-check to assert /guides/kv-cache returns 200.

matt: Thanks. @squad-lead please OK if this touches customer-visible shortlinks and needs a Release Notes blurb.

squad-lead: OK to proceed with redirect. No RN needed unless partners ask — small FYI fine.

anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5301 "fix(docs): restore legacy kv shortlink + anchor" — includes redirect frontmatter and small test.

docs-bot: CI: link-check passed, preview deployed.

oliver: Reviewed and merged. Live now. Support confirmed the partner link resolves.

matt: Nice, closing the loop. If anyone spots other kv shortlinks, drop them here and Ill add to a quick sweep.
